_comment: sp4sap — generic MCP client configuration template (stdio).
Works verbatim for any MCP client that supports the mcpServers JSON shape
Replace <SC4SAP_ROOT> with the ABSOLUTE path to this plugin checkout.
Template variables are NOT expanded by configuration-file MCP servers in
most clients — use a real absolute path here.
Credentials resolve in this order (see bridge/mcp-server.cjs):
1. SC4SAP_ENV_FILE / MCP_ENV_PATH  (absolute path to a profile sap.env)
4. SAP_* variables in the env block below (no file needed)
NEVER put a SAP password in this file. Use a keychain: reference in the
profile sap.env, or export it from a secret manager at launch time.
